title: ep1.0_research_preview.md
variant: stick-figure dialogue reel v2 · the recorded takes over a temp stem
logline: The cold open for flow: the calm answer, the hailstone, the invite he accepts without looking, the rewind to 1993. Stick figures and text cards stand in for the picture.

_measure.lines_note: the script's two MAS blocks in sc 1 are one sentence, recorded and placed as one take (e1-co-1-02)
_measure.longest_conversation: 1.01-1.02: the host's question and Mas's answer (2 turns)
_measure.printed_clock: cold open 0:00-0:40 in the script (sc 1 0:20, sc 2 0:10, sc 3 0:05, sc 4 0:04 + toast)

beats.frame: WIDE · the one wide: stage, banquet, the lit window
beats.caption: Mas in the armchair, the Orb at his shoulder; at frame right only the host's hand and a card. Behind: the banquet's ovation, and far off one lit window.

lines.text: Last one, Mas. What's the best part of the job?

seq.place: APEC CEO Summit, San Francisco · main stage

beats.real: NOV 16, 2023 · APEC CEO Summit, San Francisco [V]
cues: sound: the hall (HVAC, a polite crowd), the banquet louder; no music
the host: a hand and a PA voice, never a face (unnamed, never gendered)
the lit window is OGAL-A-RAM's: no label, no face, a phone's glow

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas, answering; the window soft behind him
beats.caption: Mas answers, unhurried. As he starts, a white dot, a HAILSTONE, leaves the lit window and arcs toward us over the bay. We see it; he doesn't.

lines.text: "…i've gotten to be in the room when we sort of push the veil of ignorance back—and the frontier of discovery forward…"

beats.real: NOV 16, 2023 · the "veil of ignorance" answer, trimmed [V]
cues: one sentence, one read: the take plays on across the next two cuts
the hailstone crosses behind him; no pan splits the sentence

beats.frame: INSERT · the shared table from above: plink
beats.caption: Plink: the hailstone lands in his glass and bobs, glyph noise, no letters. The host's glass sloshes; his water line doesn't move.
cues: cut in on the dash: the plink lands in the read's own phrase break
the tent card reads for the whole insert
open: show his phone here, face-up and dark (sc 2 needs it by the glass)

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas, the sentence lands
beats.caption: Back on his face for "discovery forward." Far behind him the lit window's phone clicks off; the banquet's applause swells.
cues: the same MCU setup as 1.02
the swell rises into the freeze and is cut by it, mid-rise

beats.caption: Everything freezes into navy and cream, mid-slosh, mid-ovation. Two things stay in colour: Mas, and his phone on the table.
cues: style: 2-TONE FREEZE, a full-room pass; Mas never freezes
music: MM-14 "Freeze F4", one dry piano F4, left to ring
sound: the hall drops to a low filtered hum, never silence

beats.caption: The phone lights: an invite in a generic calendar UI. Four attendee circles, no names: a doorway, a glowing page, a spinner, a black square.
beats.real: the noon call on Friday is real (facts #46) [V]; the invite itself is invented
cues: held a bar to read; the buzz is the one close sound
egg: none of the four circles is GERG's green laptop glow

beats.frame: SINGLE · MCU Mas: he reads it, looks up
beats.caption: He reads it and looks back up. On "noted." his thumb taps Accept below frame, eyes up. The light on his jaw goes pale blue. He sips.
cues: the hold is his; the tap plays inside it (no insert of the thumb)
jaw light white -> pale blue at 1.35 s: the only sign he accepted
the clock (Friday, noon) states no outcome

beats.frame: TWO-SHOT · Mas and the Orb: the iris steps
beats.caption: The Orb's iris steps from the phone to Mas in three drawings. A toast pops beside it.
cues: music: MM-06 movement I (1993 beeper tier) enters under the F4's decay
the Orb, his witness, carries "how did he get here?" across the cut

beats.caption: The room scrubs backward: the ovation sits, the water climbs home, the hailstone flies back across the bay. Four light steps to paper white.
cues: style: BASE -> 1-BIT in four held light steps (reel: 1-BIT end only)
sound: the hall runs backward, stepping down with the light

beats.caption: Paper white, a 3:2 pillarbox. Alone in the middle, a 1-bit alert: OK, and Cancel greyed out with a 50% dither. No computer, no hand.

seq.place: a 1-bit dialog (no computer, desk or hand)

cues: style: F1.1 1-BIT, an era switch; date card top-left, 3:2 pillarbox
music: MM-06's chip notes on F, uneven, stepping (never even: X3)
plants the rule: he always takes the offer (paid at Act Four's noon)

beats.caption: The Orb's toast, now in 1-bit. SMASH TO the main titles.
cues: the toast is the joke: its read plus a beat, then SMASH TO the intro
